query_log.found: Cross-checked DFKI author-hosted report, §§2.1–2.3, Table 3 and Appendix A.1. For exact preprocessing and train/test separation read MASTER_filter_and_combine_datasets.m in the raw archive.

interpretation.acquisition: One real six-joint industrial robot. Twelve MAT recordings with three designed trajectories per file, each run twice (36 designs; 72 executions). The last filename in the author processing order is held out. Time steps within a raw file are 4 ms. Results summarize acquisition files and axes, not independent samples.
interpretation.ports: The MAT embedded README calls tau_ref_ff feedforward, tau_fb_meas the position-control feedback contribution, and tau_meas real motor torque. The report §2.2 states torque is inferred from winding currents and the motor torque constant. Table 3 sketches a torque sum; Appendix A.1 Eq. 13 describes commanded torque. Subtracting the same-index sum of the two logged terms from tau_meas yields a channel consistency diagnostic. No independent calibrated load-side torque, pre/post-limiter pair or limiter flag is evidenced here. A difference is not a measured clipping event; the archive does not establish its cause.
interpretation.axes: For axes 1 to 3 use secondary encoders; axes 4 to 6 do not have this sensor and the corresponding q_se_meas fields are constant zero in all files. Use the motor resolver for these axes per the author script.
interpretation.prepared: Prepared files in the two archives are byte-identical copies. In each split, forward model input torques and inverse model target torques match exactly. The script concatenates files within split, applies forward-backward filtering, constructs shifted and filtered inverse-model inputs, then takes every 25th sample. Do not count tasks, copies or train/test views as extra acquisitions or use acausal preprocessed features as real-time inputs.
interpretation.time: In each prepared split the script uses linspace(0,n*0.1,n); the effective timestamp increment is slightly larger than 0.1 s. Both saved time vectors and nominal step are retained.
interpretation.definitions: RMS per file and joint, no lag fit. measured_minus_FF_plus_FB_rms_Nm = RMS(tau_meas - (tau_ref_ff + tau_fb_meas)). The >0.01 Nm count uses an analyst-selected numerical difference threshold, not a hardware limit. Positions are degrees, torques are motor-side Nm.
interpretation.coverage: All 12 raw MAT files and both prepared MAT files analyzed. Videos and saved performance model excluded.

reproduce: Extract both official RAR files separately with a RAR-capable archive reader; run python derive_industrial_robot.py WITH_RAW_DIR WITHOUT_RAW_DIR OUTPUT_DIR (Python, NumPy, SciPy).
